Your History

Recently Viewed

Our Story — Est. Dhaka, Bangladesh

Built For
Those Who Know

01 — The Origin

Born In The
Silence Of Dhaka

OWL WEAR started with a simple frustration: streetwear in Bangladesh was either loud imitation or cheap basics. Nothing in between. Nothing made with intention.

So we built it ourselves. Premium fabrics sourced locally, silhouettes cut oversized by design, and branding so minimal it whispers instead of shouts.

02 — The Symbol

Why The Owl

The owl sees what others miss. It moves in silence and strikes with precision. Ancient cultures made it the companion of wisdom itself.

That's the energy stitched into every piece — for people who observe more than they speak, and whose presence is felt before it's announced.

What We Stand On

Three Principles

/01

Quality Over Quantity

Small drops. Heavy fabrics. 240–400gsm cotton and fleece that holds shape wash after wash. We'd rather sell out than mass-produce.

/02

Made In Bangladesh, Proudly

The world wears clothes made here without knowing it. We put our origin on the label — Dhaka-born, globally worn.

/03

Design With Restraint

No logos screaming across chests. Minimal marks, considered details, and silhouettes that do the talking.

Questions,
Answered

Orders & Shipping

How long does delivery take?+
Inside Dhaka: 1–2 working days (৳60). Outside Dhaka: 2–4 working days (৳120). Orders over ৳5,000 ship free anywhere in Bangladesh.
Do you offer Cash on Delivery?+
Yes — COD is available nationwide. You can also pay in advance with bKash, Nagad, Visa or Mastercard.
Can I track my order?+
After dispatch you'll receive a courier tracking number by SMS and email. Tracking pages for each courier partner are linked in that message.

Sizing & Fit

How does OWL WEAR fit?+
Everything is cut oversized by design. If you're between sizes, size down for a standard fit or stay true for the full streetwear silhouette. Every product page has a size finder — enter your height and weight and we'll suggest your size.
What if my size doesn't fit?+
Free size exchange within 30 days. The item must be unworn with tags attached. Contact us on WhatsApp and we'll arrange pickup and redelivery.

Returns & Quality

What is your return policy?+
30-day returns on unworn items with tags. Refunds are issued to your original payment method within 5–7 working days of us receiving the item.
How do I care for the prints?+
Wash cold, inside out. Hang dry — avoid tumble drying. Never iron directly on prints. Full care instructions are on each product page under Fabric & Care.
Are your products really made in Bangladesh?+
Yes — designed, cut, sewn and printed in Dhaka. Premium local fabrics, small batches, and we put our origin proudly on the label.
